json_schema.description:
Once you have collected information about the trip, call this function once for each day of the trip, starting on day 1.
If a field does not apply for a given day, use "-" to indicate this.
You MUST call this function to save the plan for each query.

current_city.description: The city for this day. If the plan is to travel between two cities, indicate it as "from A to B" (e.g. "from Ithaca to Charlotte").

transportation.description: e.g. "Flight Number: F3633413, from Ithaca to Charlotte, Departure Time: 05:38, Arrival Time: 07:46"

breakfast.description: The name of a restaurant in the city, e.g. "Nagaland's Kitchen, Charlotte"

attraction.description: Use a ";" to separate different attractions, with each attraction formatted as "Name, City". e.g. "The Charlotte Museum of History, Charlotte;"

accommodation.description: e.g. "Affordable Spacious Refurbished Room in Bushwick!, Charlotte"

content.content:
We need to create 7-day travel plan for group of 5, departing from La Crosse (likely La Crosse, WI) visiting 3 cities in Illinois. Dates March 18-24 2022 (7 days). Budget $4800. Need accommodations suitable for children under 10, entire rooms (so maybe hotel rooms). No flights; so transportation likely car (rental) or bus. Need to output plan by calling submit_day_plan for each day. Must include fields: day, current_city, transportation, breakfast, attraction, lunch, dinner, accommodation. For each day we need to fill these. We need to decide which 3 cities: maybe Chicago, Springfield, and Peoria (or Rockford). Starting from La Crosse, drive to Chicago first, then Springfield, then Peoria, then back to La Crosse on last day. Provide attractions.

We must ensure budget: $4800 for 5 people across 7 days: average $960 per day, covering accommodation (maybe $150 per night per room, need maybe 2 rooms?), meals, transport, etc. We'll just note budget-friendly options.

We'll produce plans for each day.

Day 1 (Mar 18): Travel from La Crosse to Chicago (approx 3h drive). Transportation: Rental van (e.g., "Rental Van: Enterprise, La Crosse to Chicago, Departure 08:00, Arrival 12:00"). Breakfast maybe at home or on road; we need a restaurant. We'll list "Dunkin' Donuts, La Crosse". Attractions: maybe Millennium Park. Lunch: "Giordano's, Chicago". Dinner: "Portillo's, Chicago". Accommodation: "Family Suite, Holiday Inn Chicago Mart Plaza, Chicago (2 rooms)". Breakfast field: "Dunkin' Donuts, La Crosse". Attraction field: "Millennium Park, Chicago; Navy Pier, Chicago". Lunch and dinner as above.

Day 2 (Mar 19): Chicago. Transportation: "Walking, Chicago". Breakfast: "Wildberry Pancakes, Chicago". Attractions: "Shedd Aquarium, Chicago; Field Museum, Chicago". Lunch: "Lou Malnati's Pizzeria, Chicago". Dinner: "The Purple Pig, Chicago". Accommodation same.

Day 3 (Mar 20): Chicago to Springfield (drive ~3.5h). Transportation: "Rental Van: Enterprise, Chicago to Springfield, Departure 09:00, Arrival 13:00". Breakfast: "Yolk, Chicago". Attractions: "Lincoln Home National Historic Site, Springfield". Lunch: "Obed & Isaac's Restaurant, Springfield". Dinner: "Cozy Dog Drive-In, Springfield". Accommodation: "Family Suite, Hampton Inn Springfield, Springfield".

Day 4 (Mar 21): Springfield. Transportation: "Walking". Breakfast: "Aunty Tam's, Springfield". Attractions: "Illinois State Museum, Springfield; Abraham Lincoln Presidential Library, Springfield". Lunch: "Moe's Original BBQ, Springfield". Dinner: "Molly's Kitchen, Springfield". Accommodation same.

Day 5 (Mar 22): Springfield to Peoria (drive ~2h). Transportation: "Rental Van: Enterprise, Springfield to Peoria, Departure 09:00, Arrival 11:30". Breakfast: "Molly's Kitchen, Springfield". Attractions: "Peoria Riverfront Museum, Peoria". Lunch: "Peoria Crab House, Peoria". Dinner: "J. R. R. Pizza, Peoria". Accommodation: "Family Suite, Holiday Inn Peoria Downtown, Peoria".

Day 6 (Mar 23): Peoria. Transportation: "Walking". Breakfast: "First Watch, Peoria". Attractions: "Caterpillar Visitors Center, Peoria; Luthy Botanical Garden, Peoria". Lunch: "The Blue Duck Barbecue, Peoria". Dinner: "Miller's Ale House, Peoria". Accommodation same.

Day 7 (Mar 24): Peoria to La Crosse (drive ~5h). Transportation: "Rental Van: Enterprise, Peoria to La Crosse, Departure 09:00, Arrival 14:30". Breakfast: "First Watch, Peoria". Lunch: "Stop at La Crosse Deli, La Crosse". Dinner: "-". Accommodation: "-". Since returning home, no accommodation.
